# California Treatment Centers

> An informational guide to luxury and premium addiction and mental-health treatment in California — levels of care, costs, insurance coverage, and how to choose a program.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://californiatreatmentcenters.com/): overview of California treatment options.
- [Addiction treatment guides](https://californiatreatmentcenters.com/addiction-treatment-guides.html): index of guides.
- [How to choose a rehab in California](https://californiatreatmentcenters.com/how-to-choose-a-rehab-california.html).
- [How much does rehab cost in California](https://californiatreatmentcenters.com/how-much-does-rehab-cost-california.html).
- [Does insurance cover rehab in California](https://californiatreatmentcenters.com/does-insurance-cover-rehab-california.html).
- Programs: [alcohol rehab](https://californiatreatmentcenters.com/alcohol-rehab.html), [dual diagnosis](https://californiatreatmentcenters.com/dual-diagnosis-treatment.html), and more.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Informational resource about treatment in California; verify specific program details, availability, and insurance directly with providers.
- Includes editorial and clinical-review policies ([editorial policy](https://californiatreatmentcenters.com/editorial-policy.html)).
